findings.title: Live-proof verdict is self-asserted, not derived from the evidence; future captured_at and any program named codegraph are accepted
findings.detail: Own repro (scratch): evidence file containing 'lumen_verify.sh --golden\nrecall 0.10 FAIL\nexit 1', entry verdict PASS, kind live -> P4 PASS. Repro A: three evidence files whose whole content is the command text ('codegraph trust me', 'git log', 'lumen ok'), self-computed sha256, P6 captured_at 2099-01-01, plus the lumenignore pair, a Lumen status and a hand-written drift report -> verdict PASS, complete, rc=0. cmd '/tmp/evil/codegraph --version' is accepted for P5 (basename allow-list). --captured-not-before is chosen by the caller, so the freshness bound can be 1970. The documented honest boundary (index_health.md N2 paragraph) covers a forger writing a consistent file; it does not cover a gate that passes an entry whose own evidence says FAIL, nor a capture dated in the future. 11.4.115(F), 11.4.262, 11.4.201.
findings.required_fix: Derive the proof verdict from a machine-readable line in the evidence (e.g. the lumen_verify.sh / codegraph result record) and FAIL when the entry verdict disagrees; reject captured_at later than the gate's run time; record the resolved argv[0] and refuse a path outside the declared tool locations (or record it honestly as unverified). Add the two forgeries (contradicting evidence, future date) as RED cases.

findings.title: Drift report binding checks scope and .lumenignore sha only: head and lumen_scope_sha256 are not verified, check rcs are self-asserted
findings.detail: Own repro: a hand-written scope-drift/1 report with head 'deadbeef', all three checks rc 0, the real sha256 of scope.yaml and .lumenignore (one sha256sum each) -> P-ScopeDrift PASS. The same report with lumen_scope_sha256 set to 64 zeros -> PASS: scope_drift_check.sh writes lumen_scope_sha256 but p_drift never compares it, so a stale config/index/lumen_scope.json is not caught by the binding. The reviewer forgery 'hand-written drift report' is rejected only when its hashes are wrong.
findings.required_fix: Bind lumen_scope_sha256 to a --lumen-json input (FAIL on mismatch or when unchecked, listed in not_checked otherwise); bind head to a supplied --repo HEAD (git rev-parse) or record it as unverified; state in the doc that check rcs are instance-tier (11.4.240(F)).
